card.name: Reported figures called an underestimate
card.fires_on: Words in a sentence saying a reported frequency or figure is probably too low, such as 'may be an', 'underestimates' and 'underestimate'. It fires just before or on the word underestimate.

modes.label: Frequency may be an underestimate
modes.description: Linking words after 'reported frequency' that lead into the word underestimate in adverse reaction text.

modes.label: The word underestimate itself
modes.description: The word underestimate or underestimates, said of risk or reporting rates.
modes.example: It is likely that this experience underest<<imates>> the degree of risk that might occur with

modes.label: Estimated figure is the tip of the iceberg
modes.description: General web text saying a count is only a small part of the true number.
modes.example: hurt by discarded litter. With many pet and farm owners going direct to vets, and many injured wild animals never being found, it is estimated that this<< figure>> is just the tip of the iceberg.

card.writes: It pushes toward words about being true or accurate (including Chinese 真实 and 准确), which fits comments on how accurate a figure is.
card.plain: It lights up when a text says a reported number is probably lower than the real one.
